messages:
sahil: Kicking off follow-up from the recent multi-vendor outage. Need clear owners, short mitigations, and timelines. Reply with ack + ETA. I'll pull into the exec digest.

maria: Ack. I'll own registry durability + read-fallbacks. Short-term: add read-retry with jitter and local metadata cache. ETA: patch by Thu, design for geo-replication next week.

paul: I'll take auth-provider resilience. Plan: JWKS caching + local token minting when upstream unavailable, with strict audit logging. PoC by next Wed.

anne: Vendor comms / contract updates. I'll propose an "emergency response" SLA amendment and request a direct escalation contact. Draft to procurement by Fri.

leah: Ops ask: throttle-sensitive routes should scale down request rate instead of failing hard. I'll add adaptive throttling + observable counters. ETA: staging flags by Mon.

ops-oncall: I'll set up cross-zone synthetics and a runbook section for vendor key rotation failures. Staging probes by Tue, prod in 72h if stable.

devops-bot: Created tasks:
```
INF-3799 registry-read-fallbacks (assignee: maria)
INF-3800 auth-jwks-cache-and-mint (assignee: paul)
INF-3801 vendor-sla-emergency-clause (assignee: anne)
INF-3802 adaptive-throttling-metrics (assignee: leah)
INF-3803 cross-zone-synthetics (assignee: ops-oncall)
```
Links: https://jira.redwoodinfra/INF-3800

sahil: Good. Two short rules: 1) automatic model fallback allowed only for public endpoints with a conservative circuit-breaker (10% failures over 2m -> trip). 2) any fallback must log fallback_reason and increment metric fallback_triggered.

maria: Note: we need a small schema bump to store metadata checksum and last-sync-ts. Will include migration steps in the doc.

paul: Security note: minted fallback tokens must be short-lived (<=2m) and include audited claims. We'll store issuance events in our audit bucket.

leah: Adding metric names: adaptive_throttle_rate and fallback_triggered. Will also create a dashboard tile for postmortem review.

ops-oncall: Scheduling a focused DR run Friday 10:00 PT to exercise auth-down + registry-read-errors + vendor quota exhaustion. Please RSVP.

anne: Vendor update: vendor CS agreed to meet next Tue; procurement will push the emergency clause. I asked for an AE contact this week.

sahil: Action owners recap: maria (INF-3799), paul (INF-3800), anne (INF-3801), leah (INF-3802), ops-oncall (INF-3803). Weekly status updates in Jira; escalate blockers here before infra sync.

leah: RSVP'd for DR run.

maria: Will post the registry patch PR by Thu and link tests.

paul: Starting PoC for INF-3800, will share test harness soon.

sahil: Thanks everyone. I'll publish a one-paragraph exec summary tomorrow. If vendor talks stall, call it out here and anne will escalate.
